question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Corruption be in both public and private sectors. It may be to remove it, we will not be able to build 'Sonar Bangla'. Our fail a curse not only to our nation but also all over the government world. If we is trying defined as the abuse of entrusted power for the private gain. occurs to control it with iron hand.
guide_solution: (a) Corruption is a curse not only to our nation but also all over the world. (b) It may be defined as the abuse of entrusted power for the private gain. (c) It occurs in both public and private sectors. (d) Our government is trying to control it with iron hand. (e) If we fail to remove it, we will not be able to build 'Sonar Bangla'.
